title: Red Hat Security Advisory: tesseract security update
description: Multiple heap out-of-bounds and stack buffer overflow vulnerabilities were discovered in the Tesseract OCR engine. These flaws can lead to information disclosure, arbitrary code execution, denial of service, and heap corruption when processing crafted data or .traineddata files. Red Hat has issued an important security update for Tesseract in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 to address these issues.
